# Pytest Results Reference

This document provides a structured view of the test suite, focused on **physics validation** (`test_placement_forces.py`, `test_analytical_contact.py`, `test_magnet.py`) and **regression tracking** (`test_svg_render.py`, `test_placement.py`). It is regenerated on demand via `scripts/regen_pytest_report.sh`.

> **Regeneration**: Run `./scripts/regen_pytest_report.sh` to update this document with current test results.
>
> **When to run each area**: see the Test Area Partition table below. Markers are defined in `pyproject.toml` under `[tool.pytest.ini_options] markers`; fixture-based markers (`minimal`, `dccf`) gate on the corresponding fixture file in `tests/fixtures/`.

```{python}
#| label: env-setup
#| output: false
# Portable harness: repo root by walking up to pyproject.toml (works whether
# Quarto executes with cwd=docs or cwd=repo), test interpreter = Quarto's own
# kernel python unless QUARTO_PYTHON points at the project .venv, and
# PYTHONPATH=src so the suite imports without an installed package.
import os, pathlib, sys
def _repo_root():
    d = pathlib.Path(os.getcwd()).resolve()
    for _ in range(6):
        if (d / "pyproject.toml").exists():
            return d
        d = d.parent
    return pathlib.Path(os.getcwd()).resolve()
REPO_ROOT = _repo_root()
REPO = str(REPO_ROOT)
PYTEST_PY = os.environ.get("QUARTO_PYTHON", sys.executable)
PYTEST_BASE = [PYTEST_PY, "-m", "pytest", "--color=no"]
def _pytest_env():
    env = dict(os.environ)
    src = str(REPO_ROOT / "src")
    env["PYTHONPATH"] = src + (os.pathsep + env["PYTHONPATH"] if env.get("PYTHONPATH") else "")
    return env
PYTEST_ENV = _pytest_env()
```

## Test Area Partition

| Area | Marker / Keyword | Fixture | When to run | Test files |
|------|-----------------|---------|-------------|------------|
| **Placement physics** | `physics` | tube111 / DCCF | After force-law, integrator, or contact changes; before release | `test_placement_forces.py`, `test_analytical_contact.py`, `test_magnet.py`, `test_placement_settle.py`, `test_placement_movement.py`, `test_placement_power.py` |
| **Placement behavior** | `unit` | minimal / none | After any placement or contact edit; fast CI gate | `test_placement_frames.py`, `test_placement_layers.py`, `test_placement_pairs.py`, `test_placement_tight.py`, `test_placement.py`, `test_courtyard_behavior.py`, `test_ghost_create.py`, `test_motion_roundtrip.py` |
| **Routing** | (none by default) | minimal / tube111 / DCCF | After router, grid, obstacle, or corridor changes | `test_routing_astar.py`, `test_routing_grid.py`, `test_routing_obstacles.py`, `test_routing_search.py`, `test_routing_smooth.py`, `test_routing_smooth_detour.py`, `test_routing_tight_spot.py`, `test_routing_pour.py`, `test_routing_tht_free_via.py`, `test_routing_crossing.py`, `test_routing_chunked.py` |
| **DRC / output** | (none by default) | minimal | After DRC, output, or rip-up changes | `test_drc_routing.py`, `test_track_ripup.py`, `test_gnd_strip.py`, `test_stitch.py` |
| **Server / CLI** | `server` / `cli` | minimal | After HTTP API or CLI entry-point changes | `test_server.py`, `test_server_manual.py`, `test_server_docs.py`, `test_run_autoroute.py`, `test_io.py` |
| **Board model / IO / S-expr** | `unit` | minimal | After parsing, S-expr, or board-model changes | `test_sexpr.py`, `test_board_model.py`, `test_io.py`, `test_validate.py` |
| **Pour / power** | `unit` | minimal | After pour, power-membership, or fanout changes | `test_pour.py`, `test_power_membership.py` |
| **SVG render** | `regression` | tube111 / DCCF | After SVG render or preview changes | `test_svg_render.py`, `test_padless_graphical.py` |

**Quick command reference** (run from repo root):

| Goal | Command |
|------|---------|
| Fast CI gate (unit only) | `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -m unit -q` |
| Physics validation | `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -m physics -q` |
| Regression tracking | `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -m regression -q` |
| DCCF fixture tests | `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -m dccf -q` |
| Minimal fixture tests | `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -m minimal -q` |
| Full suite | `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -q` |
| Single test file | `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_<name>.py -q` |

> **Marker definitions** (from `pyproject.toml`):
> - `unit`: Pure unit tests — no fixtures, no I/O
> - `params`: PlacementParams validation/serialization
> - `physics`: MST force-spring simulation (requires nets)
> - `cli`: CLI entry point tests
> - `server`: HTTP API endpoint tests
> - `regression`: Bug fix verification
> - `minimal`: Uses `minimal.kicad_pcb` fixture (4 footprints, no nets)
> - `dccf`: Uses `DCCF.sved.kicad_pcb` fixture (97 footprints, 59 nets)

**Total test files**: 36 in `tests/`

```{python}
#| label: test-file-list
#| output: asis
files = sorted(p.name for p in REPO_ROOT.glob("tests/test_*.py"))
for f in files:
    print(f"- `tests/{f}`")
```

## 1. Placement Physics

These tests validate the **force laws**, **integrator**, and **collision detection** — the core of the SI placement dynamics.

**When to run**: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -m physics -q`

### 1.1 Force Matrix Behavior (`test_placement_forces.py`)

Each test isolates one force by zeroing others, asserting qualitative behavior.

| Test Class | Tests | Validates |
|------------|-------|-----------|
| `TestOverlapLaw` | 4 | Courtyard push grows with penetration; continuous at contact; coincident parts separate via MTV |
| `TestAttractionRepulsionEquilibrium` | 3 | Pad pair settles at $d = \sqrt{k_r/k_a}$; attraction pulls; no attraction → drift apart |
| `TestCourtyardRole` | 2 | Without courtyard, overlap persists; halo reaches before contact |
| `TestBoundaryRole` | 1 | Wall holds against Coulomb shove |
| `TestGhostRole` | 2 | Ghost pulls target; ghost never moves |
| `TestRigidProjection` | 4 | Kabsch snap preserves shape exactly; monotonic drift; angular deadband; no stiffness knob |

```{python}
#| label: run-physics-tests
#| output: asis
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    PYTEST_BASE + ['tests/test_placement_forces.py', '-v', '--tb=short'],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=REPO, env=PYTEST_ENV
)
print("```")
print(result.stdout[-5000:] if len(result.stdout) > 5000 else result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:")
    print(result.stderr[-2000:])
print("```")
print(f"Return code: {result.returncode}")
```

## 2. Regression Tests

Bug-fix verification and render correctness.

**When to run**: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -m regression -q`

### 2.1 SVG Render Correctness (`test_svg_render.py`)

| Test | Validates |
|------|-----------|
| `test_preview_matches_accept_with_rotation` | Preview SVG == Accept SVG (no group-transform approximation) |
| `test_tube111_back_footprints_inside_region_in_svg` | B.Cu parts render in correct region (no mirror bug) |
| `test_tube111_back_pad_rect_uses_effective_angle` | Pad angle from file used directly (no double-count with footprint angle) |
| `test_preview_rotates_square_pads_with_part` | Copper rotates with courtyard in preview |
| `test_forces_overlay_per_cause_arrows` | Each force cause gets colored arrow + marker |
| `test_forces_overlay_falls_back_to_total` | Legacy single-arrow fallback works |

```{python}
#| label: run-svg-render-tests
#| output: asis
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    PYTEST_BASE + ['tests/test_svg_render.py', '-v', '--tb=short'],

print("```")

## 5. HTML Report (Self-Contained)

For detailed per-test output, the HTML report is generated at `docs/_output/test_report.html` (gitignored). Regenerate with:

```bash
./scripts/regen_pytest_report.sh
```

The report includes:
- Pass/fail status per test
- Tracebacks for failures
- Duration per test
- Filtering by marker/keyword
